rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a military invasion into another territory.

example.english: This invasion left many civilians homeless.
example.traditional: 呢次入侵令好多平民流離失所。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 jap6 cam1 ling6 hou2 do1 ping4 man4 lau4 lei4 sat1 so2

rows.note: Use this formal term when emphasizing an aggressive military invasion or act of aggression.

example.english: The international community unanimously condemned this act of invasion.
example.traditional: 國際社會一致譴責呢次侵略行動。
example.jyutping: gwok3 zai3 se5 wui6 jat1 zi3 hin2 zaak3 ni1 ci3 cam1 loek6 hang4 dung6

rows.note: Use this for an unwanted entry or the spread of cancer cells, bacteria, or similar agents into a body.

example.english: The scan showed an invasion of nearby tissue by cancer cells.
example.traditional: 掃描顯示癌細胞已經侵入附近組織。
example.jyutping: sou3 miu4 hin2 si6 ngaam4 sai3 baau1 ji5 ging1 cam1 jap6 fu6 gan6 zou2 zik1
